spirit:component.spirit:name: tdc_gpx_lidar_ctrl_v2

spirit:modelParameter.spirit:name: G_BUS_IDLE_STABLE_TIME_NS
spirit:modelParameter.spirit:displayName: G Bus Idle Stable Time Ns

spirit:component.spirit:description: V2 integrated Motor/Laser, optional Echo LVDS frontend, four-chip TDC-GPX acquisition, PACKED17 Rise/Fall AXI streams, unified 32-control/32-status CSR and runtime IRQ.

spirit:parameter.spirit:name: G_CSR_CLK_MHZ
spirit:parameter.spirit:description: Must match s_axi_csr_aclk. Phase timeout conversion uses this value.

spirit:parameter.spirit:name: G_PROC_CLK_MHZ
spirit:parameter.spirit:description: Must match proc_aclk. Routine sign-off profiles use 150 or 200 MHz.

spirit:parameter.spirit:name: G_TDC_CLK_MHZ
spirit:parameter.spirit:description: Must match i_tdc_clk. Physical timing values are converted in this domain.

spirit:parameter.spirit:name: G_STREAM_CLK_MODE
spirit:parameter.spirit:description: SYNC requires equal frequencies and one shared physical clock net.

spirit:parameter.spirit:name: G_NUM_CHIPS
spirit:parameter.spirit:description: Controls all per-chip GPX bus and flag vector widths.

spirit:parameter.spirit:name: G_STOPS_PER_CHIP
spirit:parameter.spirit:description: Controls Echo LVDS/STOP width and logical APD capacity.

spirit:parameter.spirit:name: G_MAX_RETURNS_PER_STOP
spirit:parameter.spirit:description: Compile-time capacity. Runtime selection may use 1 through this value.

spirit:parameter.spirit:name: G_RISE_CAPABILITY_MASK
spirit:parameter.spirit:description: Four-bit mask; may overlap the falling mask for per-chip dual-edge capture.

spirit:parameter.spirit:name: G_FALL_CAPABILITY_MASK
spirit:parameter.spirit:description: Use 0000 for rising-only hardware.

spirit:parameter.spirit:name: G_OUTPUT_WIDTH
spirit:parameter.spirit:description: Build-time width for both Rise and Fall AXI streams.

spirit:parameter.spirit:name: G_NUM_FACES
spirit:parameter.spirit:description: Build-time polygon face count; runtime geometry uses only these faces.

spirit:parameter.spirit:name: G_ENABLE_ECHO_RECEIVER
spirit:parameter.spirit:description: Compile the low-latency LVDS-to-GPX STOP frontend and expose its ports.

spirit:parameter.spirit:name: G_ENABLE_ECHO_SIMULATION
spirit:parameter.spirit:description: Compile the synthetic Echo source. Requires Echo Receiver enabled.

spirit:parameter.spirit:name: G_OEN_MODE
spirit:parameter.spirit:description: Select the contract that matches the parent PCB wiring.

spirit:parameter.spirit:name: G_PHASE_TIMEOUT_US
spirit:parameter.spirit:description: CSR-domain bound for configuration and operation phases.

spirit:parameter.spirit:name: G_POWERUP_TIME_NS
spirit:parameter.spirit:description: Converted to TDC clocks with ceiling arithmetic.

spirit:parameter.spirit:name: G_RECOVERY_TIME_NS
spirit:parameter.spirit:description: Converted to TDC clocks with ceiling arithmetic.

spirit:parameter.spirit:name: G_ALU_PULSE_TIME_NS
spirit:parameter.spirit:description: Converted to TDC clocks with ceiling arithmetic.

spirit:parameter.spirit:name: G_BUS_IDLE_STABLE_TIME_NS
spirit:parameter.spirit:description: Physical quiet interval before bus ownership changes.

spirit:parameter.spirit:name: G_DRAIN_MARGIN_TIME_NS
spirit:parameter.spirit:description: Bounded post-read margin for physical GPX drain.
